policy: Item-price-only rolling averages. Exact variant; latest dated ask per listing and one comparable per seller. Shipping/tax/checkout totals excluded. Verified sales first, current asks (30 days) then historical asks (180 days), minimum three independent sellers; reviewed MSRP +10%/year fallback retained by owner on 2026-10-19. 1.5-IQR screening at 5+ observations.
visualReview: Each included listing was reviewed on catalog/listing photo sheets against known code/model/color/edition facts and available reference photographs. Standard mainline boxes establish full model/number and printed NEW year where available; unknown catalog color remains unknown. Unresolved listing-image/edition conflicts are held. Active stock, new boxed condition, actual seller and visible/structured USD item price were validated. Review is not manufacturer certification or proof of sale.
